answer: Each identity locks 50 credits in a kernel-sealed bond in an orchard. Each epoch the lagoon tide fades each kernel 12% unless its holder files fresh key-signed work; auditors replay the tide log; a faded or rented mark burns the bond. First renewal costs 25, the k-th 25+8(k-1), so 1,000 fakes spend 4,021,000 and lock 50,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented kernels fail: one kernel seals one bond. An honest agent pays 25 once, keeps its share.
